The project aims to secure American leadership in AI, create hundreds of thousands of jobs, and support national security and economic growth. The initial $100 billion deployment has begun, with key technology partners including Arm, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Oracle, and OpenAI collaborating on the buildout, which started in Texas. OpenAI will continue expanding its use of Microsoft Azure as part of this effort, and the project seeks partnerships across the data center infrastructure sector for land, power, construction, and equipment.

item.title: OpenAI seeks partnerships across US data center infrastructure sectors to support AI development [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI and its strategic partners are pursuing collaborations with companies involved in various aspects of data center infrastructure, including power, land, construction, and equipment, to build the necessary foundation for advancing Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). item.title: OpenAI partners with Axios to expand AI tools and funding for local newsrooms in four US cities, enhancing news ecosystem and ChatGPT content access [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has expanded its collaboration with the news industry by partnering with Axios to support local news coverage in Pittsburgh, Kansas City, Boulder, and Huntsville. This partnership is part of OpenAI's broader effort to help publishers adopt AI tools and strengthen the news ecosystem while providing ChatGPT users with access to information from trusted publications. The initiative builds on OpenAI's existing partnerships with nearly 20 media organizations, including News Corp, The Atlantic, and Vox Media, reaching over 160 news outlets in more than 20 languages. These collaborations enable ChatGPT to feature summaries and excerpts from reliable sources with clear citations, improving user engagement and discovery of original news content. OpenAI's work also includes helping publishers integrate AI tools to enhance newsroom operations and business models, such as the Associated Press's use of AI for translations and content optimization, and The Atlantic's experiments with AI-driven research and interactive tools. This ongoing effort aims to foster innovation in journalism through technology while maintaining a commitment to trustworthy and objective news.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Adebayo Ogunlesi to Board of Directors to enhance leadership in infrastructure and finance for AGI development [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has appointed Adebayo Ogunlesi, Founding Partner and CEO of Global Infrastructure Partners and former Senior Managing Director at BlackRock, to its Board of Directors. Ogunlesi brings extensive experience in corporate finance, infrastructure investment, and global market strategy to support OpenAI's mission toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). Ogunlesi's background includes senior roles at Credit Suisse and legal experience as a clerk for U.S. Supreme Court Justice Thurgood Marshall. His expertise is expected to help OpenAI navigate AI infrastructure transformation, drive innovation, and foster economic growth as the company advances its AI technologies.

item.title: OpenAI plans to evolve its corporate structure to strengthen its non-profit arm supported by its for-profit success, aiming to better align with its mission to ensure AGI benefits all humanity [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI is reevaluating its dual non-profit and for-profit structure to better support its mission of ensuring artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. The company intends to maintain both arms, with the for-profit entity's success providing sustainable funding for the non-profit to advance its goals. Since its founding in 2015 as a research lab, OpenAI has shifted from relying on donations to raising significant capital through a for-profit startup model to support compute-intensive AI development. This structure includes a capped-profit for-profit controlled by the non-profit, designed to balance investor returns with mission-driven outcomes. OpenAI's evolution reflects the increasing capital demands of AI research and its commitment to safety, capability, and positive impact. The planned structural changes aim to ensure long-term sustainability and effectiveness in pursuing AGI, recognizing the scale of investment required and the importance of aligning organizational design with mission objectives.

item.title: OpenAI introduces deliberative alignment to teach o-series models safety specifications and reasoning for safer responses [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has launched a new alignment strategy called deliberative alignment for its o-series language models, which involves directly teaching the models human-written safety specifications and training them to reason explicitly about these rules before responding. This approach enables the models to reflect on user prompts, identify relevant policy text, and generate safer answers without relying on human-labeled examples. Deliberative alignment significantly improves adherence to OpenAI's safety policies and outperforms previous models like GPT-4o across various safety benchmarks. By allowing models to deliberate on safety standards during inference, this method addresses limitations of prior approaches that depended on indirect learning from labeled data, offering a promising path to enhance AI safety through improved reasoning capabilities.

item.title: OpenAI launches o1 model with function calling, vision, and structured outputs plus Realtime API updates and new fine-tuning and SDK tools for developers [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced the o1 model in its API, designed for complex multi-step reasoning with features like function calling, structured outputs, developer messages, and vision capabilities. The update also includes improvements to the Realtime API with WebRTC integration and reduced pricing, a new preference fine-tuning method, and beta Go and Java SDKs to enhance developer customization and performance. The o1-2024-12-17 snapshot improves on previous versions with better cost-efficiency and state-of-the-art benchmark results, outperforming GPT-4o in function calling and structured output tasks. The Realtime API enhancements aim to support low-latency conversational applications such as voice assistants and live translation, with easier integration and more control over responses. OpenAI is gradually expanding access to these new tools and features for developers.

item.title: OpenAI says Elon Musk proposed and created a for-profit structure for OpenAI in 2017 but left after demands for control were rejected [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI detailed a timeline showing Elon Musk's evolving involvement with the organization, highlighting that he questioned the nonprofit model at its start in 2015 and later advocated for a for-profit structure in 2017. Musk created a public benefit corporation as a proposed future structure but left after OpenAI rejected his demands for majority equity and full control. The timeline includes Musk's resignation as co-chair in 2018 and his subsequent founding of a competing AI company, xAI, in 2023. OpenAI emphasized its mission-driven approach and urged Musk to compete in the marketplace rather than through legal actions, underscoring the importance of innovation and free market competition in AI development.

item.title: OpenAI launches Sora Turbo video generation model at sora.com with up to 1080p resolution and 20-second videos, available to ChatGPT Plus and Pro users [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released Sora Turbo, an upgraded version of its video generation model, allowing users to create videos up to 1080p resolution and 20 seconds long in various aspect ratios. The model supports generating new videos from text or remixing existing assets and is accessible at sora.com for ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers. Sora includes features like a storyboard tool for precise frame input and community feeds showcasing creations. Usage limits vary by subscription tier, with Pro users receiving higher resolution and longer duration options. OpenAI has implemented safeguards such as visible watermarks, metadata for provenance, and content abuse prevention measures to promote responsible use. The company plans to expand access and refine pricing in the future while continuing to improve the technology's realism and affordability.

item.title: OpenAI launches Sora, a video generation model that creates and edits videos from text, images, and video inputs up to 1080p resolution [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Sora, a video generation model that produces new videos from text, images, or existing videos, supporting up to 1080p resolution and 20-second clips. Sora builds on technologies from DALL·E and GPT, using a diffusion process and transformer architecture to maintain consistency across frames and follow detailed text instructions. The model can animate still images, extend videos, and fill in missing frames, aiming to enhance storytelling and creative expression. Trained on diverse datasets including public, proprietary, and human-labeled data, Sora incorporates safety measures to mitigate risks such as misuse or generation of misleading content. OpenAI engaged with creative professionals worldwide to refine the model and its safeguards before deployment.

item.title: Minne Atairu uses Sora platform to challenge patriarchal imagery and redefine cultural icons
item.description: Interdisciplinary artist Minne Atairu employs the technology platform Sora to realize her creative vision by challenging patriarchal imagery and redefining cultural icons. item.title: Filmmaking duo Vallée Duhamel discusses Sora's role in reshaping their creative process and world-building
item.description: Filmmakers Vallée Duhamel explain how the Sora technology helped them perceive reality differently and contributed to constructing new worlds in their projects. The Sora product was discontinued as of April 26, 2026.

item.title: Animator Lyndon Barrois uses Sora software to create immersive storytelling worlds before its discontinuation in April 2026
item.description: Animator and filmmaker Lyndon Barrois discusses how he uses the animation software Sora to craft immersive storytelling experiences and create new worlds. item.title: OpenAI outlines ways to integrate AI tools into product teams to improve development and collaboration [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI discusses how product teams can leverage artificial intelligence to enhance productivity, support decision-making, and improve collaboration. The article highlights practical applications of AI technologies to streamline product development processes and boost team effectiveness.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Pro subscription with advanced AI models and enhanced compute for complex problem solving [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Pro, a $200 monthly subscription plan offering unlimited access to its most advanced AI models, including the new o1 pro mode that provides more reliable and comprehensive responses for complex tasks. The service targets researchers, engineers, and professionals who require high-performance AI for data science, programming, and legal analysis. ChatGPT Pro includes access to models such as OpenAI o1, o1-mini, GPT-4o, and Advanced Voice, with o1 pro mode using additional compute to improve accuracy and reliability. OpenAI is also awarding 10 ChatGPT Pro grants to medical researchers at leading U.S. institutions to support research benefiting humanity, with plans to expand grants to other regions and fields. The company intends to add more compute-intensive features to the Pro plan over time while continuing to enhance capabilities for other subscribers.

item.title: OpenAI releases o1 system card detailing safety evaluations and risk management for o1 and o1-mini models [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has published a system card for its o1 and o1-mini language models, outlining the safety measures and evaluations conducted prior to their deployment. The report highlights the use of reinforcement learning with chain-of-thought reasoning to improve safety and robustness, alongside external red teaming and frontier risk assessments aligned with OpenAI's Preparedness Framework. The o1 model series was trained on a combination of public, proprietary, and custom datasets, with rigorous data filtering to reduce risks such as disallowed content and bias. The system card includes details on safety challenges, evaluation checkpoints, and performance improvements, emphasizing OpenAI's ongoing commitment to iterative deployment and risk management for these advanced reasoning models.

item.title: OpenAI partners with Future to integrate content from over 200 specialist media brands into ChatGPT [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has formed a strategic partnership with Future, a global specialist media platform, to provide ChatGPT users access to content from Future's portfolio of more than 200 media brands, including Marie Claire, PC Gamer, and TechRadar. The content will be presented with attribution and links to original articles to ensure transparency and further reading. Future, a UK-based FTSE 250 company, has already incorporated OpenAI's technology in its chatbots and internal operations to enhance user engagement and productivity. This partnership aims to expand Future's audience reach while enriching the ChatGPT experience with diverse, trusted specialist content.

item.title: Morgan Stanley uses AI evaluations and GPT-4 to enhance financial advisors' workflows and client engagement, achieving 98% adoption of its internal AI assistant [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Morgan Stanley partnered with OpenAI to integrate GPT-4 into its wealth management workflows, creating AI tools that help financial advisors retrieve information faster, automate summarization, and tailor insights to client needs. The firm developed a rigorous evaluation framework to ensure AI reliability and compliance, leading to widespread adoption of its AI assistant by over 98% of advisor teams. The evaluation process included testing summarization accuracy, multilingual translation, and retrieval from a large document corpus, with continuous refinement based on expert feedback. Morgan Stanley also launched AI-powered meeting summary tools that convert Zoom recordings into actionable client notes and follow-ups, improving advisor efficiency while maintaining human oversight. To address security and compliance, Morgan Stanley implemented daily quality assurance tests and benefited from OpenAI's zero data retention policy, ensuring proprietary data privacy. The AI tools have increased advisor engagement and enabled faster client follow-ups, positioning Morgan Stanley to expand AI-driven services in financial advising.

item.title: OpenAI advances red teaming by combining external human experts and automated AI methods to improve AI safety testing [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI is enhancing its red teaming efforts by integrating human expertise with automated AI techniques to identify potential risks and improve the safety of its AI models. The company released two papers detailing its approach to external red teaming campaigns and a new automated red teaming method aimed at scaling risk discovery. The approach involves selecting diverse external experts based on testing goals, providing them access to different model versions, and offering clear instructions and interfaces for effective testing. OpenAI emphasizes the importance of red teaming to proactively assess risks such as misuse and cultural nuances, helping to build benchmarks and safety evaluations that evolve alongside AI capabilities.

item.title: Grab fine-tunes GPT-4o vision to improve mapping accuracy and efficiency for Southeast Asia's complex road networks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Grab, a leading rideshare and food delivery company in Southeast Asia, has enhanced its mapping service, GrabMaps, by fine-tuning OpenAI's GPT-4o vision model. This fine-tuning enables more accurate localization of traffic signs and lane counts, improving map data quality for over 42 million users across eight countries. The improvements help address the region's unique mapping challenges, such as narrow streets and rapidly changing urban environments. Using millions of street-level images collected from drivers equipped with 360-degree cameras, Grab fine-tuned GPT-4o with a small sample set, boosting speed limit sign localization accuracy from 67% to 80% and increasing lane count accuracy by 20%. These advances reduce manual mapping efforts and operational costs while enhancing data reliability for both Grab's internal operations and enterprise customers. Grab is also expanding its AI capabilities with projects like a multilingual voice assistant for visually impaired users and an advanced support chatbot to improve user experience. The company views AI as a key tool to better serve its partners and users across Southeast Asia.

item.title: Rox integrates OpenAI models to enhance sales productivity and aims to make every seller a top 1% performer [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Rox has developed a sales platform that combines its commercial expertise with OpenAI's language models to unify fragmented data and provide AI-powered assistance to sales teams. The platform uses a multi-layered approach with AI agents that monitor accounts and support sales reps, boosting productivity by 50% and doubling sales-accepted pipeline for beta clients. The platform's design includes data unification with smaller models, complex reasoning with mid-tier models, and advanced interaction capabilities using GPT-4o and OpenAI's Realtime API. Rox's approach is informed by customer feedback and partnerships, enabling tailored workflows and scaling top sellers' best practices across teams. Since its launch, Rox has grown to 25 enterprise accounts in seven months, reporting significant time savings and increased customer engagement.

item.title: OpenAI opens its first continental European office in Paris to expand AI partnerships and support in France's technology ecosystem [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has established its first office in continental Europe, located in Paris, to deepen collaboration with French businesses, institutions, and developers. The Paris office will enable OpenAI to work closely with partners such as Sanofi, Simplon, Mirakl, and ESCP Business School, who are already using OpenAI's tools for healthcare, digital skills training, marketplace growth, and personalized education. OpenAI also plans to strengthen ties with the French government and contribute to the responsible development and sharing of AI benefits in the region.

item.title: The Estée Lauder Companies adopt ChatGPT Enterprise to analyze consumer data and enhance product development and marketing across 20+ beauty brands [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: The Estée Lauder Companies are using ChatGPT Enterprise to process and analyze extensive consumer data, enabling faster insights and supporting creativity in product development and marketing for their portfolio of over 20 beauty brands. They established a GPT Lab to develop custom AI tools that address specific business needs, such as analyzing fragrance preferences and clinical trial results. The GPT Lab rapidly prototypes and tests AI applications, prioritizing those with high impact and quick development cycles. Custom GPTs include tools for extracting consumer insights from surveys, assessing skincare product effectiveness, generating brand-aligned copywriting, and synthesizing vendor information, helping employees across the company make data-driven decisions more efficiently.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Search to provide fast, timely answers with links to relevant web sources, available to all ChatGPT users by early 2025 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Search, a feature that enables users to obtain quick, up-to-date answers with direct links to original web sources. The feature integrates natural language chat with web search, allowing users to ask questions conversationally and receive responses supported by current information from trusted publishers. ChatGPT Search is initially available to ChatGPT Plus and Team users, with plans to roll out to all free users in the coming months. The system uses a fine-tuned GPT-4o model combined with third-party search providers and partnerships with major news organizations to deliver accurate and attributed content. OpenAI aims to improve the search experience further and expand access across platforms and user types throughout 2025.

item.title: Promega accelerates manufacturing, sales, and marketing by adopting ChatGPT across 80% of its workforce with over 1,400 custom GPTs [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Promega, a leader in life sciences, has integrated ChatGPT throughout its organization, using over 1,400 custom GPTs to enhance workflows in manufacturing, sales, and marketing. This top-down adoption, driven by CEO Bill Linton and supported by an AI Advisory Council, aims to improve operational efficiency and customer engagement. ChatGPT assists in complex manufacturing planning, such as forecasting equipment replacement and managing product specifications, while automating quality assurance responses to reduce workload. Sales and marketing teams use custom GPTs to streamline prospect analysis and email campaign creation, significantly cutting time spent on these tasks and allowing more focus on relationship building and user experience.

item.title: OpenAI launches SimpleQA, a new benchmark to evaluate language models' accuracy on short, fact-based questions [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI introduced SimpleQA, a factuality benchmark designed to measure language models' ability to answer concise, fact-seeking questions accurately. The dataset includes 4,326 questions vetted by multiple AI trainers to ensure high correctness and covers diverse topics from science to entertainment. SimpleQA aims to challenge advanced models like GPT-4o, which currently scores below 40%, and provides an efficient evaluation process using a prompted ChatGPT classifier to grade answers as correct, incorrect, or not attempted.

item.title: Decagon partners with OpenAI to deliver scalable, fully automated customer support using GPT models [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Decagon has partnered with OpenAI to provide high-performance, fully automated customer support solutions that operate at scale for clients including Curology, Duolingo, and Notion. The platform uses a combination of OpenAI's GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and other models to handle complex inquiries and deliver fast, nuanced responses without human intervention. Decagon fine-tunes different GPT models for specific tasks, such as rewriting customer queries and managing complex decision-making workflows, optimizing both speed and accuracy. The company handles up to 91% of support interactions for some clients and rapidly integrates new OpenAI models to maintain cutting-edge performance. Decagon is also exploring voice capabilities to expand its AI-powered customer service offerings.

item.title: OpenAI simplifies and scales continuous-time consistency models to match diffusion model quality with two-step sampling [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed a new approach called sCM that simplifies the design, stabilizes training, and scales continuous-time consistency models to 1.5 billion parameters, enabling sample quality comparable to leading diffusion models with only two sampling steps. This method achieves about a 50x speedup in sample generation, producing images in 0.11 seconds on a single A100 GPU without inference optimization. The approach distills knowledge from pre-trained diffusion models and maintains consistent quality improvements as model size increases. While sCMs still rely on diffusion models for initialization and show a small quality gap, they significantly reduce computational costs and open possibilities for real-time generation in image, audio, and video domains.

item.title: OpenAI and Lenfest Institute launch AI Collaborative and Fellowship program to support local newsrooms with grants and AI tools [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has partnered with the Lenfest Institute and Microsoft to create the AI Collaborative and Fellowship program, providing grants and AI credits to local news organizations for projects aimed at improving business sustainability and innovation. The initial recipients include Chicago Public Media, Newsday, The Minnesota Star Tribune, The Philadelphia Inquirer, and The Seattle Times, each hiring AI fellows to develop AI-driven tools and solutions for journalism. The program encourages collaboration among participating newsrooms to share insights and technical developments, focusing on AI applications such as data analysis, content summarization, audience engagement, and advertising support. This initiative aims to help local journalism adapt to new technologies while maintaining ethical standards and fostering a sustainable future for independent news.

item.title: OpenAI evaluates ChatGPT fairness by analyzing response differences based on user names, finding less than 1% reflect harmful stereotypes [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI conducted a study to assess whether ChatGPT's responses vary based on users' names, which can carry gender, racial, or ethnic associations. Using a language model research assistant to analyze millions of real ChatGPT interactions while preserving privacy, the study focused on first-person fairness-how biases might affect users directly rather than third-party decisions. The analysis found no significant difference in overall response quality across names with different demographic connotations, with harmful stereotypes appearing in about 0.1% of cases. The study also noted that longer, open-ended tasks were more likely to include such stereotypes, and highlighted the need for further work to refine definitions and detection of harmful bias in AI responses.

item.title: OpenAI introduces MLE-bench to evaluate AI agents on 75 Kaggle machine learning engineering tasks with human baselines [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has launched MLE-bench, a benchmark designed to assess AI agents' performance on machine learning engineering tasks by curating 75 competitions from Kaggle. The benchmark tests skills such as model training, dataset preparation, and experiment execution, using human baselines from Kaggle leaderboards for comparison. OpenAI evaluated several language models on MLE-bench, finding that their top setup matched at least a Kaggle bronze medal in 16.9% of the competitions. The benchmark code is open-sourced to support further research into AI capabilities in machine learning engineering.

item.title: OpenAI partners with Hearst to integrate curated content from 20+ magazines and 40+ newspapers into AI products, enhancing lifestyle and local news coverage [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has formed a content partnership with Hearst to incorporate curated journalism from Hearst's extensive portfolio of magazines and newspapers into its AI products. This integration includes content from brands such as Houston Chronicle, Esquire, Cosmopolitan, and Women's Health, aiming to enrich ChatGPT's 200 million weekly users with trusted lifestyle and local news information. The partnership emphasizes the importance of professional journalism in AI outputs, with Hearst content featuring citations and direct links to original sources for transparency. Hearst's collaboration with OpenAI focuses solely on its magazine and newspaper divisions, excluding other business areas.

item.title: OpenAI launches Canvas, a new ChatGPT interface for collaborative writing and coding with GPT-4o, available now to Plus and Team users globally [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Canvas, a new interface for ChatGPT designed to enhance collaborative writing and coding projects beyond simple chat interactions. Canvas opens in a separate window, allowing users to work side by side with ChatGPT on editing, revising, and refining text and code with inline feedback and targeted suggestions. Built on GPT-4o, Canvas offers features like adjustable writing length, reading level changes, code debugging, and language porting. It is currently rolling out to ChatGPT Plus and Team users worldwide, with Enterprise and Education users to gain access soon, and plans to become available to all free users after beta. The model was trained to recognize when to open Canvas and provide precise, context-aware collaboration for creative and programming workflows.

item.title: OpenAI secures $6.6 billion funding and establishes $4 billion revolving credit facility with major banks to enhance financial flexibility [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has raised $6.6 billion from leading investors and set up a new $4 billion revolving credit facility with banks including JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Santander, Wells Fargo, SMBC, UBS, and HSBC. This facility is undrawn at closing and increases OpenAI's liquidity to over $10 billion, providing flexibility to invest in new initiatives and scale operations. The credit facility strengthens OpenAI's balance sheet and reaffirms partnerships with top financial institutions, many of which are also OpenAI customers. The company plans to use this financial support to continue investing in AI research, expand infrastructure, and attract talent as it focuses on delivering helpful AI tools globally.

item.title: OpenAI raises $6.6 billion at $157 billion valuation to expand AI research, compute capacity, and tools for global benefit [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has secured $6.6 billion in new funding at a $157 billion post-money valuation to accelerate its mission of making artificial general intelligence beneficial and accessible to all. The company aims to enhance its leadership in frontier AI research, increase computing resources, and develop tools that help users solve complex problems worldwide. Currently, over 250 million people use ChatGPT weekly for work, creativity, and learning, while businesses and developers leverage OpenAI's platform to improve productivity and build new applications. OpenAI plans to collaborate with partners, including the U.S. and allied governments, to foster an AI-powered ecosystem that benefits everyone.

item.title: OpenAI launches Realtime API for low-latency speech-to-speech applications with GPT-4o model [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced the Realtime API in public beta, allowing developers to build low-latency, natural speech-to-speech experiences using the GPT-4o model. The API supports streaming audio inputs and outputs over a persistent WebSocket connection, enabling more natural conversations and automatic handling of interruptions similar to ChatGPT's Advanced Voice Mode. It also supports function calling to trigger actions or retrieve context during interactions. The Realtime API is priced based on text and audio tokens, with audio input costing approximately $0.06 per minute and output $0.24 per minute. It is designed for applications such as language learning, customer support, and health coaching, with early partners like Healthify and Speak already using it. OpenAI has implemented multiple safety layers, including automated monitoring and human review, to mitigate abuse risks. Audio capabilities will also be added soon to the Chat Completions API, allowing responses in text, audio, or both.

item.title: OpenAI adds image-based fine-tuning to GPT-4o API, enabling enhanced vision capabilities for developers [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced vision fine-tuning for its GPT-4o model, allowing developers to customize the model using both images and text to improve visual understanding tasks. This update supports applications such as visual search, object detection, and medical image analysis by enabling fine-tuning with as few as 100 images. Several partners have demonstrated the benefits of vision fine-tuning: Grab improved traffic sign localization and lane counting for mapping by up to 20%, Automat increased desktop bot success rates for UI automation by over 270%, and Coframe enhanced website content generation consistency by 26%. OpenAI continues to monitor safety and privacy for fine-tuned models while winding down the fine-tuning platform for new users as of May 2026.

item.title: OpenAI launches Prompt Caching in API to reduce input token costs by 50% and speed up processing for repeated prompts [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Prompt Caching in its API, automatically applying discounts and faster processing to input tokens that the model has recently processed. This feature targets developers who reuse the same context across multiple API calls, such as in code editing or multi-turn chatbot conversations, aiming to reduce costs and latency. Prompt Caching is available on the latest versions of GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, o1-preview, and their fine-tuned variants, with cached input tokens charged at half the price of uncached tokens. The API automatically caches prompt prefixes longer than 1,024 tokens and increases cache size in 128-token increments, with caches clearing after 5-10 minutes of inactivity or within an hour of last use. Usage details, including cached tokens, are provided in API responses, and prompt caches are isolated per organization to maintain privacy.

item.title: OpenAI launches integrated model distillation tools in API to fine-tune smaller models using outputs from GPT-4o and o1-preview [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced a new Model Distillation feature within its API that enables developers to fine-tune smaller, cost-efficient models like GPT-4o mini using outputs from larger models such as GPT-4o and o1-preview. This integrated workflow simplifies the previously complex process by combining dataset generation, evaluation, and fine-tuning on the OpenAI platform. The Model Distillation suite includes Stored Completions for capturing input-output pairs, Evals for custom performance evaluations, and fine-tuning capabilities fully integrated to streamline iterative improvements. The feature is available now with free training tokens offered through October 31, and pricing aligns with existing fine-tuning costs beyond the free tier.

item.title: Altera builds autonomous digital humans using GPT-4o to enable long-term human-agent collaboration and emotional interaction [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Altera, led by CEO Dr. Robert Yang, is developing digital humans powered by OpenAI's GPT-4o that can autonomously interact and collaborate with people for extended periods, such as playing Minecraft like a friend. The company addresses data degradation challenges in long-term AI autonomy by combining GPT models with a brain-inspired multi-module system to simulate cognitive and emotional functions. Altera's digital humans can operate autonomously for up to four hours, outperforming other AI models in stability and task complexity. The company aims to scale this technology to create multi-agent societies for applications in gaming, productivity, and beyond, positioning itself at the forefront of human-agent collaboration innovation.

item.title: OpenAI upgrades Moderation API with GPT-4o-based multimodal model supporting text and image harm detection, improving accuracy especially in non-English languages [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced a new multimodal moderation model called omni-moderation-latest, based on GPT-4o, to its Moderation API. This model enhances detection of harmful content in both text and images, supports additional harm categories, and offers more accurate probability scores for moderation decisions. The update aims to help developers build more robust content moderation systems across various sectors. The new model improves multilingual performance significantly, with notable gains in low-resource languages and expanded support for six harm categories including violence, self-harm, and sexual content. It also adds two new text-only categories related to illicit activities. OpenAI continues to offer the Moderation API free to developers, supporting safer digital platforms by easing the workload on human moderators and enforcing content policies more effectively.

item.title: Minnesota's Enterprise Translation Office integrates ChatGPT to accelerate and improve government translation services, enhancing accessibility for non-English speakers [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Minnesota's Enterprise Translation Office (ETO) has adopted ChatGPT to streamline and enhance translation services across the state's Executive Branch, aiming to bridge language gaps for over 20% of residents who primarily speak languages other than English. This initiative addresses previous challenges of decentralized, costly, and slow translation processes by combining AI with human review to improve accuracy, speed, and cultural relevance. Since its beta launch, the ETO has processed over 3,000 translation requests and translated more than 2 million words, reducing turnaround times from weeks to under 48 hours and cutting costs by over $100,000 monthly. The office is also piloting ChatGPT's voice capabilities for real-time interpretation to further improve accessibility in live settings, with early results showing promise for broader adoption.

item.title: OpenAI partners with GEDI to integrate Italian news content into ChatGPT, enhancing local news access for users in Italy and globally [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]

item.title: OpenAI releases o1-preview model with advanced reasoning abilities, outperforming GPT-4o and human experts on math and science benchmarks [ * ] [ ◼ ]

item.title: OpenAI disrupts covert Iranian influence operation using ChatGPT to generate political content targeting 2024 US election [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI identified and banned accounts linked to an Iranian influence operation called Storm-2035 that used ChatGPT to create content on topics including the US presidential campaign, Gaza conflict, and other political issues. The operation published articles on multiple websites posing as both progressive and conservative outlets and posted comments on social media in English and Spanish, but the content failed to gain meaningful audience engagement. The operation involved a dozen social media accounts on platforms like X and Instagram, which posted both political commentary and unrelated topics such as fashion to appear authentic. OpenAI shared threat intelligence with government and industry stakeholders and continues to monitor for further attempts to misuse its services, emphasizing its commitment to detecting and preventing covert influence operations amid the 2024 election cycle.

item.title: OpenAI releases SWE-bench Verified, a human-validated subset of SWE-bench to improve evaluation of AI models on real-world software engineering tasks [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced SWE-bench Verified, a human-validated subset of the SWE-bench benchmark designed to more accurately assess AI models' ability to solve real-world software engineering problems. This release addresses issues in the original SWE-bench, such as overly specific or unrelated unit tests, underspecified problem descriptions, and environment setup difficulties that could lead to incorrect evaluations of AI-generated code. SWE-bench evaluates AI by providing code repositories and issue descriptions from GitHub, challenging models to generate patches that fix the issues. OpenAI collaborated with the original SWE-bench authors to refine the benchmark, aiming to reduce underestimation of AI capabilities and improve reliability in measuring autonomous software engineering performance as part of their Preparedness Framework.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Zico Kolter to Board of Directors and Safety & Security Committee to enhance AI safety governance [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]

item.title: OpenAI publishes GPT-4o system card detailing model capabilities, safety evaluations, and risk mitigations for multimodal AI including audio, text, and vision [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released the system card for GPT-4o, an autoregressive multimodal model that processes text, audio, images, and video inputs and outputs. The system card includes OpenAI's Preparedness Framework scorecard assessing risks such as unauthorized voice generation, speaker identification, and disallowed content, with most categories rated low or medium risk. It also outlines the model's training data sources, including public web data, proprietary partnerships, and multimodal datasets, and describes the safeguards implemented at both model and system levels to ensure safe deployment in ChatGPT and API environments.

item.title: OpenAI launches Structured Outputs in API to enforce model responses matching developer-defined JSON Schemas with 100% accuracy on new GPT-4o model [ * ] [ ◼ ]

Structured Outputs address longstanding challenges developers faced in ensuring AI-generated data matches required formats, facilitating more reliable integration in workflows such as data extraction, function calls, and multi-step agentic processes.

item.title: OpenAI introduces Rule-Based Rewards to improve AI model safety without extensive human feedback [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed Rule-Based Rewards (RBRs), a new method to enhance AI model safety by using clear, rule-driven evaluations instead of relying heavily on human feedback. This approach aims to align models with safety policies efficiently while reducing the need for large-scale human data collection. RBRs have been integrated into OpenAI's safety stack since the GPT-4 launch and are planned for future models. The method involves defining propositions about desired or undesired behaviors and applying them as rules to guide model responses, enabling fine-grained control over safety behavior through reinforcement learning techniques.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-4o mini, a cost-efficient small model with advanced multimodal reasoning and 128K token context window [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-4o mini, its most cost-efficient small language model designed to deliver advanced AI capabilities at a significantly lower price. GPT-4o mini is priced at 15 cents per million input tokens and 60 cents per million output tokens, making it more than 60% cheaper than GPT-3.5 Turbo. It aims to enable a wider range of AI applications by reducing computational costs and latency. The model includes built-in safety measures and improved resistance to prompt injections, benefiting from OpenAI's instruction hierarchy method and extensive expert evaluations.

item.title: OpenAI launches new compliance API, SCIM support, and GPT controls for ChatGPT Enterprise to enhance data security and user management [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced new compliance and administrative features for ChatGPT Enterprise, including a Compliance API integrated into the OpenAI Compliance Logs Platform, SCIM support for automated user provisioning, and expanded controls over GPT actions. The Compliance API offers time-stamped records of workspace interactions and supports integrations with leading eDiscovery and Data Loss Prevention providers to meet regulatory requirements such as FINRA, HIPAA, and GDPR. SCIM support, currently in beta, enables synchronization of internal employee directories with ChatGPT Enterprise for streamlined user management. item.title: OpenAI trains language models using prover-verifier games to improve output legibility and human verifiability in complex problem solving [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed a training method using prover-verifier games where a strong language model (prover) generates solutions that a weaker model (verifier) can easily check, resulting in outputs that are clearer and easier for humans to evaluate. This approach addresses the trade-off between optimizing for correctness and maintaining legibility, which is crucial for tasks like math problem solving. The training involves alternating between training the verifier to assess solution correctness and instructing the prover to produce solutions that are either helpful or deceptive but still verifiable by the weaker model. This method improves human evaluators' accuracy in assessing solutions and aims to balance performance with clarity, enhancing trustworthiness and usability of AI-generated content in various applications requiring precise communication.

item.title: OpenAI and Los Alamos National Laboratory partner to develop bioscience safety evaluations for multimodal AI models in laboratory settings [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Los Alamos National Laboratory have announced a research partnership to develop evaluations that assess the biological capabilities and risks of advanced multimodal AI models like GPT-4o in laboratory environments. The collaboration aims to understand how these AI systems can safely assist scientists with physical lab tasks, including cell culture and genetic transformation, by leveraging vision and voice inputs. This partnership responds to a White House Executive Order directing national labs to evaluate frontier AI models' capabilities and risks, particularly in bioscience. The evaluation will test how AI can support both experts and novices in performing safe laboratory protocols, contributing to AI biosecurity research and building on OpenAI's existing preparedness framework and commitments to frontier AI safety.

item.title: OpenAI launches CriticGPT, a GPT-4-based model that critiques ChatGPT responses to help human trainers identify errors during RLHF [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed CriticGPT, a model derived from GPT-4, designed to generate critiques of ChatGPT's code outputs to assist human trainers in spotting mistakes during Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF). This AI-assisted approach improves trainers' ability to detect errors, outperforming unassisted reviews 60% of the time. CriticGPT was trained on examples containing deliberately inserted errors and naturally occurring bugs, enabling it to produce more comprehensive and accurate critiques with fewer hallucinations than previous methods. OpenAI plans to integrate CriticGPT-like models into their RLHF labeling pipeline to better evaluate complex AI outputs, addressing challenges as models become more knowledgeable than human trainers. Despite its benefits, CriticGPT has limitations, including difficulty with long or complex tasks and the potential for hallucinated errors. OpenAI acknowledges the need for further tools to support alignment of increasingly advanced AI systems.

item.title: OpenAI launches Cybersecurity Grant Program to fund AI-driven security research and tools, supporting over 600 applications since 2023 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]

item.title: OpenAI presents a holistic natural language classification system for detecting undesired content including sexual, hateful, violent, self-harm, and harassment categories [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed a comprehensive natural language classification system designed to improve real-world content moderation by detecting a broad range of undesired content types such as sexual content, hateful speech, violence, self-harm, and harassment. This approach generalizes across various content taxonomies and outperforms existing off-the-shelf content classifiers.

item.title: OpenAI introduces consistency models for generative tasks, enabling fast one-step image, audio, and video generation with high quality and zero-shot editing capabilities [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed consistency models, a new family of generative models designed to overcome the slow iterative sampling of diffusion models by directly mapping noise to data for fast one-step generation. These models support multistep sampling to balance compute and quality, and enable zero-shot data editing tasks like image inpainting, colorization, and super-resolution without explicit training. Consistency models can be trained by distilling pre-trained diffusion models or as standalone generative models, achieving state-of-the-art FID scores of 3.55 on CIFAR-10 and 6.20 on ImageNet 64x64 for one-step generation. When trained independently, they outperform existing one-step, non-adversarial generative models on benchmarks including CIFAR-10, ImageNet 64x64, and LSUN 256x256.

item.title: OpenAI presents improved training techniques for consistency models that learn directly from data, achieving significant FID score improvements on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet 64×64 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed enhanced methods for training consistency models, a type of generative model that produces high-quality samples in a single step without adversarial training. These new techniques allow the models to learn directly from data rather than distilling from pre-trained diffusion models, addressing previous limitations and biases in evaluation metrics. The improvements include removing Exponential Moving Average from the teacher model, adopting Pseudo-Huber losses, introducing a lognormal noise schedule, and increasing discretization steps during training. These changes, combined with better hyperparameter tuning, enabled the models to achieve FID scores of 2.51 on CIFAR-10 and 3.25 on ImageNet 64×64 in one step, representing a 3.5× and 4× improvement over prior approaches. Two-step sampling further reduces these scores, surpassing previous distillation-based methods and narrowing the gap with state-of-the-art generative models.

item.title: Paf deploys ChatGPT Enterprise company-wide with 85 custom GPTs to boost developer productivity and integrates AI into its grit:lab coding academy [ * ] [ ◼ ]

item.title: Clay achieves 10x year-over-year growth by integrating GPT-4 to automate sales research and data enrichment with its AI agent Claygent [ * ] [ ◼ ]

item.title: OpenAI appoints retired U.S. Army General Paul M. Nakasone to Board of Directors to enhance cybersecurity oversight [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has appointed retired U.S. Army General Paul M. Nakasone, a cybersecurity expert and former leader of US Cyber Command and the National Security Agency, to its Board of Directors. Nakasone will join the Board's Safety and Security Committee to advise on critical safety and security decisions as OpenAI advances its AI technology. Nakasone's role reflects OpenAI's focus on securing its AI systems, including training supercomputers and sensitive data, while exploring how AI can improve cybersecurity defenses for institutions frequently targeted by cyber attacks. His experience aligns with OpenAI's mission to develop artificial general intelligence safely and beneficially.

item.title: OpenAI and Apple announce partnership to integrate ChatGPT into iOS, iPadOS, and macOS later in 2024 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Apple have announced a partnership to integrate ChatGPT technology into Apple's iOS, iPadOS, and macOS platforms later this year. The integration will enable users to access ChatGPT's capabilities, including image and document understanding, directly within Apple experiences such as Siri and systemwide Writing Tools. The integration, powered by GPT-4o, will allow users to generate content and images, with privacy protections that prevent OpenAI from storing requests and obscure users' IP addresses. Users can access ChatGPT features for free without an account or connect their ChatGPT subscription accounts to access paid features within Apple's ecosystem.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Sarah Friar as CFO and Kevin Weil as CPO to lead finance and product teams amid global growth [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has appointed Sarah Friar as Chief Financial Officer and Kevin Weil as Chief Product Officer to support its expanding global operations and product development. Friar brings experience from roles including CEO of Nextdoor and CFO of Square, while Weil has held senior product positions at Planet Labs, Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. These leadership additions aim to help OpenAI scale its research and product efforts responsibly as it advances toward artificial general intelligence.

item.title: OpenAI details Voice Engine text-to-speech model design and safety research, including limited releases and safeguards against misuse [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI provides an in-depth explanation of its Voice Engine, a text-to-speech model that generates human-like audio from text and a 15-second voice sample. The article covers the model's development since 2022, its use in ChatGPT's Voice Mode, and limited API releases featuring professional voice actors. It also highlights the company's ongoing safety research and collaboration with global partners to prevent misuse, including policies against impersonation and measures like watermarking and monitoring. The Voice Engine employs a diffusion process to create audio without fine-tuning for specific speakers, supporting diverse voices and accents. OpenAI has engaged policymakers and trusted partners to raise awareness about synthetic voice risks and to explore protections such as phasing out voice-based authentication and promoting transparency in AI-generated content. These efforts aim to ensure responsible deployment and inform future synthetic voice safety standards.

item.title: 10BedICU uses OpenAI models to enhance India's critical care infrastructure with telehealth and AI tools across 200 hospitals in nine states [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: 10BedICU, an initiative of the eGov Foundation, is improving critical care access in India by partnering with government hospitals to provide advanced medical equipment and telehealth services. The program, which began during the 2021 COVID-19 Delta wave, now connects over 200 hospitals through the CARE electronic medical record platform to support specialized care in underserved areas. The initiative integrates OpenAI's technology to develop tools like CARE Scribe, which transcribes doctor-patient interactions into medical records in multiple Indian languages, and CARE Device Connect, which uses GPT-4 Vision to integrate data from older hospital monitors. These tools aim to reduce healthcare providers' administrative burden and enable continuous patient monitoring, helping to address the shortage of specialists and improve critical care delivery across India.

item.title: OpenAI develops scalable sparse autoencoders to identify 16 million interpretable features in GPT-4's internal activations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI researchers have created new scalable methods using sparse autoencoders to decompose GPT-4's internal neural activations into 16 million distinct, often interpretable features. This approach aims to better understand the model's complex computations by identifying sparse patterns that correspond to human-understandable concepts. The team trained large autoencoders on GPT-4 and GPT-2 activations, demonstrating improved scaling and introducing new metrics for feature quality. While many features are interpretable, challenges remain, including incomplete coverage of the model's behavior and difficulty validating interpretations. OpenAI has open-sourced their paper, code, and visualizations to encourage further research in model interpretability and hopes this work will aid in monitoring and steering language model behavior in the future.

item.title: OpenAI disrupts five covert influence operations using AI for deceptive content, reports no significant audience growth from these activities [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has terminated accounts linked to five covert influence operations that used its AI models to generate deceptive content across multiple languages and platforms. These operations, originating from Russia, China, Iran, and Israel, targeted political topics including conflicts in Ukraine and Gaza, elections, and government criticisms. Despite these efforts, OpenAI reports that these campaigns did not achieve meaningful audience engagement or reach through its services. The company emphasizes its commitment to preventing AI misuse and enhancing transparency, collaborating with industry and government to counter covert influence operations.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Edu, an affordable AI platform for universities with GPT-4o, advanced tools, and enterprise-grade security [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Edu, a version of ChatGPT designed for universities to responsibly deploy AI across students, faculty, researchers, and campus operations. Powered by GPT-4o, it offers advanced capabilities like data analysis, web browsing, and document summarization, along with enterprise-level security and administrative controls. The platform supports higher message limits, multiple languages, and custom GPT creation within university workspaces. It aims to build on existing AI use cases in education, such as personalized tutoring, research assistance, and language learning, while ensuring data privacy by not using conversations to train OpenAI models.

item.title: OpenAI launches nonprofit initiative offering up to 75% discounts on ChatGPT Business and Enterprise plans to enhance accessibility [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced OpenAI for Nonprofits, a program providing discounted access to ChatGPT Business and Enterprise plans for nonprofit organizations to help them increase productivity and social impact. Discounts include 20% off for ChatGPT Business and up to 75% off for Enterprise plans, with access to advanced AI models and tools. Nonprofits are using ChatGPT to overcome operational challenges such as limited funding and staffing shortages by automating tasks like grant proposal drafting, data analysis, and client support. Examples include organizations improving international funding access, legal aid services, public health data analysis, and resource curation. OpenAI plans to expand resources and build a nonprofit community to support AI adoption in the sector.

item.title: MavenAGI launches GPT-4 powered AI customer support agents used by Tripadvisor, Clickup, and Rho to improve service efficiency [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: MavenAGI, a new software company, has introduced an AI customer service agent built on GPT-4, which is currently deployed by companies including Tripadvisor, Clickup, and Rho to enhance customer support efficiency and quality. The technology processes diverse content, integrates with CRMs and enterprise APIs, and self-evaluates responses to provide personalized and accurate assistance across multiple support channels. The platform addresses common customer service challenges such as repetitive tasks, high costs, and slow responses by autonomously answering 93% of support questions, reducing resolution times by 60%, and doubling representative productivity. MavenAGI's AI can handle self-service queries, guide customers via chatbot, and assist human agents with real-time recommendations, continuously learning from interactions to improve over time.

item.title: OpenAI and WAN-IFRA launch Newsroom AI Catalyst accelerator to support 128 news publishers in AI adoption across Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, and South Asia [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI and the World Association of News Publishers (WAN-IFRA) have launched the Newsroom AI Catalyst, a global accelerator program designed to help 128 newsrooms adopt and implement AI technologies to improve content creation and operational efficiency. The program aims to address challenges such as misinformation, privacy, and bias while enhancing journalism quality and sustainability. The three-month program includes learning modules, workshops, a mini hackathon, and a showcase, starting with an in-person workshop to initiate AI prototyping projects. OpenAI provides funding and technical support, and the initiative targets newsrooms across Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, and South Asia to equip them with tools and knowledge for strategic AI integration.

item.title: OpenAI partners with The Atlantic to integrate its journalism into ChatGPT and future news discovery tools [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has formed a strategic partnership with The Atlantic to feature its reporting as a premium news source within OpenAI products, including ChatGPT. The collaboration will make The Atlantic's articles discoverable to millions of users and involve the publication in shaping how news is presented in upcoming real-time discovery features. The Atlantic will also have privileged access to OpenAI technology to help develop new products and improve news experiences. This partnership aligns with The Atlantic's growth and commitment to high-quality journalism, as it continues to expand its readership and innovate with AI-driven tools.

item.title: OpenAI and Vox Media form strategic partnership to integrate Vox content into ChatGPT and develop AI-powered products for audiences and advertisers [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Vox Media have announced a broad strategic partnership in which Vox Media's portfolio of brands, including Vox, The Verge, and New York Magazine, will inform ChatGPT's responses, providing brand attribution and audience referrals. The collaboration also involves using OpenAI's technology to create new products aimed at enhancing user experience and advertising effectiveness. The partnership will leverage Vox Media's extensive archives and trusted journalism to improve ChatGPT's information quality while enabling Vox Media to build AI-driven applications for consumers and advertisers. This includes enhancing Vox's affiliate commerce tool, The Strategist Gift Scout, and extending the capabilities of Forte, Vox Media's first-party data platform, to optimize ad targeting and campaign performance.

item.title: OpenAI Board Forms Safety and Security Committee to Oversee AI Project Safeguards with Recommendations Due in 90 Days [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has established a Safety and Security Committee within its Board of Directors to provide recommendations on critical safety and security decisions for all OpenAI projects and operations. The committee includes board members Bret Taylor, Adam D'Angelo, Nicole Seligman, CEO Sam Altman, and technical experts such as Aleksander Madry and Lilian Weng. Over the next 90 days, the committee will evaluate and enhance OpenAI's safety and security processes, after which it will present its recommendations to the full board and share updates publicly in a manner consistent with safety and security considerations.

item.title: OpenAI and News Corp sign multi-year global partnership to integrate premium journalism into AI products [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI and News Corp have announced a multi-year global partnership that grants OpenAI access to News Corp's current and archived journalism content from major publications worldwide. This collaboration aims to enhance OpenAI's generative AI products by incorporating reliable news sources and upholding high journalistic standards. The agreement includes content from News Corp mastheads such as The Wall Street Journal, The Times, The Australian, and others, but excludes other News Corp businesses. News Corp will also provide journalistic expertise to help maintain quality and integrity in OpenAI's offerings, reflecting a shared commitment to trustworthy information in the digital age.

item.title: OpenAI outlines safety practices for AI development and deployment, emphasizing empirical testing, alignment research, abuse monitoring, and child protection measures [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI shared an update on its safety practices at the AI Seoul Summit, highlighting its commitment to responsible AI development and deployment. The company emphasized empirical model testing, alignment and safety research, abuse monitoring, and protecting vulnerable groups such as children as key components of its approach. OpenAI detailed its use of a Preparedness Framework to evaluate model risks before release, involvement of external experts in red-teaming, and collaboration with organizations like Thorn to detect and report harmful content. The company also discussed efforts to ensure election integrity and transparency in AI-generated content through tools and metadata standards.

item.title: OpenAI details selection of ChatGPT voices from over 400 submissions with professional casting and actor collaboration [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI selected the five distinct voices for ChatGPT after a five-month process involving casting directors, talent agencies, and professional voice actors. The voices-Breeze, Cove, Ember, Juniper, and Sky-were chosen based on criteria such as diversity, timelessness, and approachability, with actors compensated above market rates. The casting process began in May 2023 with over 400 submissions from voice and screen actors. After multiple rounds of review and discussions about the technology's goals and safeguards, the final actors recorded their voices in San Francisco before the voices launched in ChatGPT in September 2023. OpenAI emphasized that the voice named Sky is not an imitation of Scarlett Johansson and paused its use out of respect following communication with Johansson's team.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out enhanced data analysis features in ChatGPT with GPT-4o, including direct file uploads from Google Drive and OneDrive and interactive tables and charts [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced new data analysis capabilities in ChatGPT's GPT-4o model, allowing users to upload files directly from Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive and interact with expandable tables and customizable charts. These features aim to simplify data handling and visualization for ChatGPT Plus, Team, and Enterprise users. Users can now work with interactive tables that update in real time during analysis and customize various chart types for presentations or documents. The improvements build on ChatGPT's ability to analyze datasets using Python code, supporting tasks like merging, cleaning, and exploring data more efficiently. OpenAI emphasizes data privacy and security, noting that user data from Team and Enterprise customers is not used for training, and Plus users can opt out of data training through controls.

item.title: OpenAI and Reddit announce partnership to integrate Reddit content into ChatGPT and develop AI features for Reddit users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Reddit have formed a partnership to incorporate Reddit's real-time content into ChatGPT and other OpenAI products, aiming to enhance user engagement and content discovery. The collaboration also includes Reddit using OpenAI's AI models to build new features for its community and moderators, and OpenAI becoming a Reddit advertising partner. The partnership leverages Reddit's Data API to provide structured, timely content to OpenAI's tools, improving the understanding and presentation of Reddit discussions, especially on current topics. OpenAI's COO led the deal, which was approved by its independent board, and Sam Altman, OpenAI's CEO, is a Reddit shareholder. This collaboration seeks to enrich both platforms by combining Reddit's vibrant community with OpenAI's AI capabilities.

item.title: Canva launches AI-powered Magic Studio using OpenAI's GPT-4 to enhance design creation for over 175 million monthly users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Canva has introduced Magic Studio, an AI-powered creative suite that integrates OpenAI's GPT-4 to simplify and accelerate design tasks for its 175 million monthly users. The suite includes tools like Magic Write for AI-assisted writing, Magic Design for generating presentations and social media content, and Magic Switch for converting designs across formats and languages. Canva aims to maintain an intuitive user experience while expanding AI capabilities, leveraging a close partnership with OpenAI to ensure safety and innovation. Since its launch, Canva's AI features have been used over 5 billion times worldwide, with the company viewing this as an early step in AI-driven design evolution.

item.title: OpenAI announces Ilya Sutskever's departure and names Jakub Pachocki as new Chief Scientist [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI co-founder and Chief Scientist Ilya Sutskever is leaving the organization to pursue a personally meaningful project. Jakub Pachocki, who has led key research initiatives including GPT-4 and OpenAI Five, has been appointed as the new Chief Scientist to continue advancing OpenAI's mission of ensuring AGI benefits everyone.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-4o, a multimodal model with real-time reasoning across audio, vision, and text, offering faster responses and improved multilingual and sensory capabilities [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced GPT-4o, its new flagship AI model that processes and generates text, audio, images, and video in real time. GPT-4o achieves response times comparable to human conversation and matches GPT-4 Turbo's performance on English text and code, while improving non-English language handling and sensory understanding. The model integrates all modalities into a single neural network, enabling richer interactions such as recognizing tone and background sounds, and producing expressive outputs like laughter and singing. GPT-4o is also faster and 50% cheaper to use via the API compared to previous models. OpenAI is exploring GPT-4o's capabilities and limitations as it represents a significant step toward more natural human-computer interaction.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-4o with audio, vision, and text reasoning and expands free ChatGPT capabilities in Spring Update [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced its Spring Update introducing GPT-4o, a new flagship model capable of real-time reasoning across audio, vision, and text. The update also expands the availability of advanced tools and features for free ChatGPT users. This release aims to enhance user experience by providing more powerful AI capabilities without additional cost.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-4o and expands advanced tools to ChatGPT free users with usage limits [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-4o, its newest flagship language model offering GPT-4-level intelligence with faster performance and enhanced capabilities in text, voice, and vision. The company is rolling out GPT-4o and additional advanced features to free ChatGPT users, including image understanding, data analysis, file uploads, and web-based responses, with message limits that switch to GPT-3.5 when reached. The update also includes a new macOS ChatGPT desktop app with voice conversation and screenshot discussion features, initially available to Plus users, with a Windows version planned later this year. OpenAI aims to make advanced AI tools more accessible worldwide while improving ChatGPT's interface and language support across more than 50 languages.

item.title: OpenAI introduces the Model Spec to standardize and guide AI model behavior, emphasizing safety, transparency, and alignment [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released the first draft of the Model Spec, a document outlining how it aims to shape and evaluate AI model behavior in its API and ChatGPT. The specification includes objectives, rules, and default behaviors designed to balance helpfulness, safety, legality, and fairness in AI responses. The Model Spec builds on OpenAI's existing research and experience, incorporating input from domain experts and ongoing alignment work. It serves as a guideline for researchers and trainers working on reinforcement learning from human feedback and is intended to evolve through public engagement with stakeholders, policymakers, and experts to refine how AI models behave responsibly and transparently.

item.title: OpenAI introduces tools for researching content authenticity and joins Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity Steering Committee [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has launched new tools to help researchers study the authenticity of online content and announced its participation in the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity Steering Committee. This initiative aims to improve transparency about the origins of digital content amid growing concerns about misinformation and AI-generated media. The company is focusing on audiovisual content provenance solutions due to their higher risk and is also researching text provenance methods, including watermarking and metadata. While text watermarking has shown accuracy against localized tampering, it is vulnerable to global tampering techniques and may disproportionately affect some user groups, such as non-native English speakers. Metadata approaches, which are cryptographically signed, are still in early exploration but hold promise for reducing false positives as generated text volume increases.

item.title: OpenAI outlines its approach to data and AI, introduces Media Manager tool for creators to control content use in AI training, plans rollout by 2025 [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has detailed its approach to data and AI, emphasizing respect for creators and content owners by developing Media Manager, a tool that will allow them to specify how their works are used in AI training. The company aims to balance AI innovation with creator rights and plans to launch this tool by 2025 to set an industry standard. The company highlights its ongoing efforts to improve AI tools like ChatGPT and DALL·E, partnering with global news publishers and educational nonprofits to enhance user experience and support content ecosystems. OpenAI also discusses the challenges of content control in AI training and its commitment to building scalable solutions that reflect creator preferences while advancing AI capabilities.

item.title: OpenAI and Stack Overflow partner to integrate OverflowAPI with ChatGPT, enhancing AI model performance and developer access to vetted technical knowledge in 2024 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Stack Overflow have announced a partnership to integrate Stack Overflow's OverflowAPI with OpenAI's ChatGPT, aiming to provide users with accurate, community-validated technical knowledge and improve AI model performance. This collaboration will allow OpenAI to leverage Stack Overflow's extensive developer content and feedback, while Stack Overflow will use OpenAI's models to enhance its OverflowAI product. The integration is expected to launch in the first half of 2024 and will include attribution to Stack Overflow contributors within ChatGPT. Both companies emphasize the partnership's goal to foster better developer experiences, promote trusted data usage, and support the growth and engagement of the Stack Overflow community through AI-driven tools and features.

item.title: Financial Times partners with OpenAI to integrate its journalism into ChatGPT and develop new AI-driven reader experiences [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: The Financial Times has entered a strategic partnership and licensing agreement with OpenAI to incorporate its journalism into ChatGPT, providing users with attributed summaries, quotes, and links to FT content. The agreement also includes collaboration on new AI products and features aimed at enhancing the reader experience. As part of the partnership, the FT has adopted ChatGPT Enterprise for its employees to leverage AI tools for productivity and creativity. The FT emphasizes the importance of transparency, attribution, and compensation in AI content use, aiming to maintain quality journalism while exploring new ways for audiences to access information through AI platforms.

item.title: Moderna partners with OpenAI to deploy ChatGPT Enterprise across its workforce, accelerating mRNA medicine development and clinical processes [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Moderna has partnered with OpenAI to implement ChatGPT Enterprise for thousands of employees, aiming to enhance productivity and innovation across all company functions. This collaboration supports Moderna's goal to bring up to 15 new mRNA-based products to market within five years, including vaccines and individualized cancer treatments. The company adopted a comprehensive change management program to achieve widespread AI adoption, including training, internal AI champions, and leadership engagement. Early results show high employee engagement with hundreds of custom GPTs created, significantly augmenting research, legal, manufacturing, and commercial operations. Moderna's integration of generative AI tools is designed to increase human capacity and clinical performance, reflecting its commitment to leveraging technology to accelerate the development of life-saving treatments.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-4 API general availability and plans to retire older Completions API models by January 2024 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has made the GPT-4 API generally available to all paying API customers and announced the general availability of GPT-3.5 Turbo, DALL·E, and Whisper APIs. The company is encouraging developers to transition from the older Completions API to the newer Chat Completions API, which now accounts for 97% of GPT usage. OpenAI plans to deprecate older models in the Completions API starting January 4, 2024, replacing them with updated models such as babbage-002 and davinci-002, and recommends developers manually upgrade their integrations. The company will continue focusing development on the Chat Completions API and aims to enable fine-tuning for GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 Turbo later this year.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-3.5 Turbo and Whisper APIs with 90% cost reduction and faster speech-to-text for developers [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced APIs for its GPT-3.5 Turbo language model and Whisper speech-to-text model, enabling developers to integrate advanced conversational AI and transcription capabilities into their applications. The new APIs offer a 90% cost reduction for ChatGPT usage since December and provide faster, more cost-effective speech recognition with the open-source Whisper large-v2 model. Early adopters include Snap Inc., which uses GPT-3.5 Turbo for its My AI chatbot on Snapchat+, Quizlet with its adaptive AI tutor Q-Chat, Instacart's planned "Ask Instacart" feature, Shopify's Shop app shopping assistant, and the Speak language learning app leveraging Whisper for conversational practice. OpenAI also refined API terms and offers options for dedicated capacity and continuous model improvements.

item.title: OpenAI adds enterprise-grade security, administrative controls, and cost management features to its API platform [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced new enterprise-focused features for its API customers, including enhanced security measures like Private Link and native multi-factor authentication, improved administrative controls with project-level management, and updates to the Assistants API for better retrieval and cost control. These enhancements aim to support large businesses and rapidly scaling developers by providing more granular oversight, compliance options, and cost-saving tools.
